customData.question: What is a single-pipeline rerun, in the model? A PipelineRun carries a full settings snapshot and emits Signals — re-scoring only sentiment produces something that is not one of those.

to.author: agent
to.tooltip:
**Two different animals in one panel.**

The four small buttons re-score a single pass and leave the other three as they were — so the run's Signals end up from two different moments, and its settings snapshot describes a whole day when it only describes a quarter. Confirmed as an accident of how it was built, not a design.

The big button does a whole day properly.

They sit at the same size, in the same panel, four rows apart.

from.tooltip:
Nothing is overwritten — a new PipelineRun is created beside the old one. That part is safe.

The part that is not obvious: the dashboard follows the newest run. So this button changes what every analyst is looking at, from a page labelled admin, with no confirmation and nothing telling them it happened.
